<div class="section-intro">
A curated discovery layer for scientific software with a verifiable public repository and enough documentation for external use or technical review. Source code, issues, releases, tests, manuals, and development history remain in the canonical repositories.
</div>

Repository classification alone is not enough for inclusion. Experimental applications are labelled explicitly and are not presented as official monitoring or management products.

::: {.qs-footnote-note}
**Catalogue note.** The authoritative repository inventory is maintained in `qselmer/qselmer`. This website synchronizes only the curated software subset into `assets/data/software.json`; editorial inclusion rules are stored in `software/registry.json`. Incomplete, undocumented, private, concept-stage, or not-yet-defensibly-classified repositories remain outside the primary software catalogue.
:::
